title: Forgiveness in Daily Life
definition: Forgiveness in daily life is the believer's willingness to release bitterness and extend mercy because God has forgiven them in Christ.
summary: Forgiveness does not excuse evil or remove the need for wisdom, repentance, or boundaries. It reflects the mercy received from God.
christFocus: Christ forgave sinners at great cost and teaches His people to forgive as they have been forgiven.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Forgiveness does not excuse evil or remove the need for wisdom, repentance, or boundaries. It reflects the mercy received from God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
